title: Majura ya zehra
body:
Majura ya zehra
Ya ali, ya fatima zahra..(2)
Haider ali, ya zahra..(3)
Mai chahta hu ke ashoor karbala me karu..(2)
ho mere saath saath ehle aza..(2)
har ek shaheed ke marqad pe jaake nauha padhu..(2)
jo ek wada meri rooh se liya rabne
use wafa to karu..(2)
Paye ziyarat e mazloom-e-karbala jau
karu husain ke marqad pe khoob sina zani..(2) aur uske baad feza me karu buland sadaa...
Husain Husaina..(2)
Azamallaho lakal ajra alayh bil musiba ya zehra ya ali
<<MINI>>
katle mawlana hussain ibne ali
<<DIVIDER>>
ya aliyun ya aliyun ya ali
majurah ya zahra majurah ya zahra
maju ya haider ali
ya ali x 3
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Haaye, Baat jab alame arwaah me karbal ki chali
Pesh Allah bapa majlis e shabbir hui
kaun zehra ka azadar hai ye baat khuli..(2)
kehne lage ambiya..Majurah ya zahra
<<DIVIDER>>
ehle falak ne kaha.. Maju ya hussain
2. Haaye Aur fir matami halqo me bate ehle aza
goonj uthi haaye husaina ki sadao se fiza
har azadar ne jab matame zanjeer kiya..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
zakhmo se aayi sada majurah ya zehra
behte lahu ne kaha..Maju ya husain
3. Haaye, Dekh kar chaand moharram ka har ek aankh hai nam aur ghar ghar me sajaya gaya gaazi ka alam
farshe majlis pe gaye kaale libaso me jo hum..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
lab pe yahi thi buka majurah ya zehra
ashko ne gir kar kaha maju ya hussain
4. Haaye, Marsiya dilne padha ashk jo barsaye husain
ho salam aap pe ae fatima ka jaye husain
<<DIVIDER>>
farshe majlis pe jo zakir ne kaha haaye husain..(2)
nauha bani ye sada majurah ya zehra
zikr hai ashoor kaa.... ya husain ya husain ya husain
qotelal husain o be karbala
<<DIVIDER>>
zibehal husain o be karbala
5. Are asr ka hangaam tha aur aale payambar
halqe shahedee pe chala zulm ka khanjar
ret ke teele pe khadi zainab e muztar
<<DIVIDER>>
sue najaf dekh ke kehti thi ye rokar
<<MINI>>
azamallahu lakal ajra alayh
bil musiba ya zahra ya ali
katle mawlana hussain ibne ali
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Haaye, Hogaye pamaal e sitam laashe bahattar
laash rahe dasht me naizo pe gaye sar
loot ne sadaat ko phir aaye sitamgar
kehne laga shame ghariba ka wo manzar
<<MINI>>
azamallahu lakal ajra alayh
bil musiba ya zahra ya ali
katle mawlana hussain ibne ali
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Are nikle haram nauha kuna fir se safar par
ek rasan bara gale aur khule sar
qafela salaar bane aabid e muztar
tauq o salasil me gala nauha labo par
<<MINI>>
azamallahu lakal ajra alayh
bil musiba ya zahra ya ali
katle mawlana hussain ibne ali
<<DIVIDER>>
Chali janibe zindaan juhi zainab e zeeshan..(2)
sare dasht uthi mazhar o irfan sada
husain husain maula..(2)
farzand e zehra tere sabr ko salaam
athara baras wala hamshakle payambar tha
beenayi gayi sheh ki jab uske laga naiza
<<MINI>>
ye ghum tha qayamat ka
<<DIVIDER>>
gaazi ke kate shane, qasim ke hue tukde
do laashe labe darya, the auno mohammad ke
<<MINI>>
ye ghum tha qayamat ka
<<DIVIDER>>
ek teer laga aakar besheer ke gardan par
baad uske sare maqtal, maula pe chala khanjar
Ya zahra ya mehdi
